thesis: Stasis turns the untap step from a rule into a resource: the controller must keep paying blue mana while denying both players normal recovery.

canonicalIdentity.originalPrintedText: Players skip their untap steps. At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this enchantment unless you pay {U}.

playbook.role: Establish a way to pay or reset Stasis—extra land drops, untap effects, bounce, or a protected alternate mana source—before locking the table. Cast it when the opponent is tapped down and your board can exploit the frozen state.

counterplay.directAnswers: Remove or counter Stasis, attack the blue upkeep payment, use free spells and alternate mana, or hold resources until the lock breaks. Instant-speed interaction before the controller's upkeep is especially valuable.
